title: 2026 Membranous Nephropathy  分子標的、病理分型、KDIGO 2021 指引與臨床實戰
description: 整合 Brenner & Rector's The Kidney (Ch 31, 32, 42) 與 KDIGO 2021 指引之權威膜性腎病變講堂，PLA2R, THSD7A, NELL1 分子機制、次發性/惡性腫瘤鑑別、EM 組織學分期與 KDIGO 風險分層治療。

sections.title: Section 1: Molecular Autoantigens & Etiologic Classification of Membranous Nephropathy
sections.content:
### 1. Brenner 11e & KDIGO 2021 權威引述與分子病態生理學 (Authoritative Citations & Pathophysiology)

依據 *Brenner & Rector's The Kidney (11th ed.)* Chapter 31 "Primary Glomerular Disease" (p. 1012-1025)、Chapter 32 "Secondary Glomerular Disease" 及 Chapter 42 "Onconephrology" (Table 42.7) 與 *KDIGO 2021 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Glomerular Diseases* Chapter 3 "Membranous Nephropathy" (Section 3.1 & Figure 29) 之定義：

Membranous Nephropathy (MN) 為由抗體介導podocyte固有抗原或沉積抗原引發之自體免疫絲球體病變。致病抗體主要為 **IgG4 亞型**，subepithelial space 原位形成免疫複合物，活化補體系統產生 Membrane Attack Complex (C5b-9 MAC)，進而引發podocyte骨架瓦解與重度非選擇性蛋白尿。

#### Molecular Autoantigen Spectrum:
* **PLA2R1 (M-type Phospholipase A2 Receptor 1)**: 占 Primary MN 70%–80%。血清中 Anti-PLA2R 滴度與疾病活動度、kidney biopsy陽性率及蛋白尿量呈高度正相關。KDIGO 2021 指引明確規定：血清 Anti-PLA2R 陽性且 eGFR 正常者，Biopsy Exemption。
* **THSD7A (Thrombospondin Type-1 Domain-Containing 7A)**: 占 Primary MN 3%–5%。女性比例高，且高達 20% 之 Anti-THSD7A 陽性患者合併有隱匿性惡性腫瘤 (Occult Malignancy, 如膽囊癌、結腸癌)。目前 KDIGO 不允許單憑 THSD7A 陽性豁免kidney biopsy。
* **NELL1 (Neural EGFL-Like 1)**: 占 5%–10%。與惡性腫瘤、Lipoic Acid 等次發性病因密切相關。
* **EXT1/EXT2 (Exostosin 1 / Exostosin 2)**: 主要出現在 Lupus Nephritis Class V (Membranous Lupus Nephritis)，IF 常伴隨 C1q 與 Full-House 沉積。
* **Semaphorin 3B, PCDH7, NCAM1**: 見於特定兒童膜性腎病變或自體免疫相關特殊分型。

### 2. Topology Mapping Matrix
* **Primary Autoantigens**:
  - **PLA2R (Phospholipase A2 Receptor)**: 占 Primary Membranous Nephropathy 約 70-80%。與 Serum Anti-PLA2R Titer、Disease Activity、Proteinuria 嚴格平行。
  - **THSD7A (Thrombospondin Type-1 Domain-Containing 7A)**: 占 3-5%。高達 20% 患者可能伴隨 Occult Malignancy。
  - **NELL1 (Neural EGFL-Like 1)**: 常與 Secondary Etiologies (Malignancy, Traditional Medicine, Lipoic Acid) 相關。
  - **EXT1/EXT2 (Exostosin 1/Exostosin 2)**: 主要出現在 Lupus Nephritis Class V (Membranous Lupus Nephritis)。
  - **Semaphorin 3B**: 主要出現在 Pediatric Membranous Nephropathy。
  - **PCDH7 & NCAM1**: 見於特定 Complement-rich 或 Autoimmune-associated 膜性腎病變。

### 3. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table
| Feature | Primary Membranous Nephropathy | Malignancy-Associated / Secondary MN |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dominant IgG Subclass** | IgG4 predominance (Brenner Table 42.7) | IgG1, IgG2, or IgG3 predominance (Brenner Table 42.7) |
| **Glomerular Staining** | Diffuse subepithelial Anti-PLA2R (+), NO C1q | Anti-PLA2R (-), C1q (+), Full-House staining |
| **Hypercellularity** | Pure capillary thickening, NO mesangial/endocapillary proliferation | Mesangial or endocapillary hypercellularity present (>8 inflammatory cells/glomerulus) |
| **Ultrastructure** | Subepithelial deposits ONLY | Subepithelial + Subendothelial / Mesangial deposits + Tubuloreticular Inclusions |

### 4. Pathophysiological Decision Tree
```
[Adult Patient with Nephrotic Syndrome]
       │
       ├─► Check Serum Anti-PLA2R Antibody Titer (KDIGO Fig 29)
       │     ├─► Positive (>20 RU/mL) ──► High Specificity for Primary MN (Consider Biopsy Exemption if eGFR normal)
       │     └─► Negative ──► Evaluate Secondary Etiologies
       │
       └─► Secondary Screening Panel (Brenner Table 42.7):
             ├─► Malignancy Screening (Age > 65, Smoking > 20 pack-years, IgG1/IgG2 predominance)
             ├─► Infections (Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, Syphilis)
             ├─► Drugs (NSAIDs, Penicillamine, Bucillamine, Gold)
             └─► Autoimmune (Lupus Class V: EXT1/EXT2 +, C1q +)
```

### 5. Conceptual Trap Analysis
1. **IgG Subclass Trap**: Primary MN 以 **IgG4** 為主（抗podocyte固有抗原）；而 Secondary / Solid Tumor-Associated MN 則以 **IgG1 與 IgG2** 為主（腫瘤脫落抗原與循環免疫複合物）。(依據 Brenner Chapter 42 Table 42.7)
2. **PLA2R Negative Trap**: 就算 Serum Anti-PLA2R 為負值，切片 Tissue Staining 仍可能呈 PLA2R 陽性；此外必須加做 THSD7A 與 NELL1 檢測以防漏診隱匿性腫瘤。

sections.title: Section 2: Ultrastructural Staging & Histopathological Diagnosis
sections.content:
### 1. Brenner 11e Brenner 11e Pathological Staging

依據 *Brenner & Rector's The Kidney (11th ed.)* Chapter 31 (Section: "Pathology of Membranous Nephropathy", Table 31.5 & Figures 31.7, 31.8, 31.9) 所載：

LM 下典型呈現腎小球毛細血管壁彌漫性增厚，No endocapillary hypercellularity。在 PAM (Periodic Acid-Methenamine Silver) EM 下，GBM 與 Subepithelial Electron-Dense Deposits 之交互關係劃分為四大超微結構分期 (Ultrastructural Ehrenreich & Churg Stages)：

* **Stage I**: 沉積物剛出現於 Subepithelial space，GBM 尚未反應，PAM 染色無 Spikes。
* **Stage II**: GBM Spikes formation，PAM 染色可見經典之 Spike Pattern (Brenner Fig 31.8)。
* **Stage III**: GBM Encirclement / Encasement，使沉積物完全埋入增厚之 GBM 內部。
* **Stage IV**: 沉積物被吸收清除，留下一圈圈不規則的透光空腔，Moth-eaten appearance，代表慢性修復期。

### 2. Topology Mapping Matrix
* **Ultrastructural EM Stages of Membranous Nephropathy**:
  - **Stage I**: Small subepithelial electron-dense deposits along the outer aspect of GBM without projections of basement membrane material.
  - **Stage II**: Projections of GBM material ("Spikes") extend between subepithelial electron-dense deposits (PAM / Silver stain demonstrates "spike formation").
  - **Stage III**: Deposits are completely surrounded and encircled by newly formed GBM material, producing marked GBM thickening.
  - **Stage IV**: Thickened GBM shows irregular lucent areas ("moth-eaten appearance") where electron-dense deposits have undergone resorption and clearing.

### 3. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table
| EM Stage | Light Microscopy (Silver/PAM Stain) | Electron Microscopy Features (Brenner Fig 31.7) | Clinical Remission Potential |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage I** | Normal or mild diffuse thickening | Subepithelial deposits, NO GBM spikes | High responsiveness |
| **Stage II** | Distinct "Spikes" protruding outward | Projections of GBM between deposits (Brenner Fig 31.8) | Active immune deposition |
| **Stage III** | Double-contour appearance / Encasement | Deposits completely encircled by GBM | Advanced structural lesion |
| **Stage IV** | Irregularly thickened GBM | Lucent, moth-eaten spaces after deposit clearing | Chronic scarring phase |

### 4. Pathophysiological Decision Tree
```
[In Situ Immune Complex Deposition in Subepithelial Space]
       │
       ▼
[Subepithelial IgG4 & C3 Accumulation (Brenner Fig 31.9)]
       │
       ▼
[Complement Activation: C5b-9 Membrane Attack Complex (MAC)]
       │
       ▼
[Podocyte Cytoskeletal Rearrangement & Slit Diaphragm Disruption]
       │
       ▼
[Severe Non-selective Nephrotic Proteinuria]
```

### 5. Conceptual Trap Analysis
1. **Stage IV vs Active Disease**: Stage IV 代表沉積物吸收後的修復期（Moth-eaten appearance），不一定代表免疫反應仍處於 Active Phase。(依據 Brenner Table 31.5)
2. **C1q & Mesangial Deposit Trap**: 凡切片出現顯著 C1q 沉積、Mesangial Deposits 或 Endothelial Tubuloreticular Inclusions，極力暗示 Lupus Nephritis Class V 或 Secondary MN。

sections.title: Section 3: Nephrotic Complications & Hypercoagulability Management
sections.content:
### 1. Brenner 11e & KDIGO 2021 Hypercoagulability Pathophysiology

依據 *Brenner & Rector's The Kidney (11th ed.)* Chapter 30 "Pathophysiology of Proteinuria" & Chapter 31 以及 *KDIGO 2021 Guidelines* Chapter 3 (Section 3.3)：

Membranous Nephropathy Hypercoagulability DVT/PE Renal Vein Thrombosis, RVT 發生率最高者。致病機制包括：
1. **抗凝血蛋白尿中流失**: 低分子量之 Antithrombin III (AT-III, 65 kDa)、Protein S 及 Plasminogen 隨蛋白尿大量流失。
2. **促凝血因子肝臟代償性合成**: 高分子量之 Fibrinogen、Factor V、VIII 及 VWF 於肝臟過度合成。
3. **低血清蛋白與血小板高反應性**: Serum Albumin < 2.0–2.5 g/dL 引發有效血管內容量不足與血液濃縮。

當 MN Flank Pain、肉眼血尿或 eGFR 急劇下降時，必須高度警覺併發 **Renal Vein Thrombosis (RVT)**。(KDIGO 指引建議當 Serum Albumin < 2.0–2.5 g/dL 且出血風險低時，應啟動預防性抗凝血治療)。

### 2. Topology Mapping Matrix
* **Hypercoagulability Risk in Membranous Nephropathy**:
  - **Highest Risk Among Glomerulopathies**: Membranous Nephropathy 擁有所有 Glomerular Diseases 中最高的 Thromboembolism (DVT, PE, RVT) 發生率。
  - **Renal Vein Thrombosis (RVT)**: 臨床表現為突發性 Flank Pain, Gross Hematuria, Acute Drop in eGFR, 及 Progressive Proteinuria。
  - **Pathophysiological Mechanisms**:
    1. Urinary Loss of Anticoagulants: Low-molecular-weight Antithrombin III, Protein S, and Plasminogen are lost in urine.
    2. Hepatic Overproduction: Compensatory hepatic synthesis of high-molecular-weight Fibrinogen, Factor V, Factor VIII, and VWF.
    3. Hemoconcentration & Platelet Hyperreactivity: Hypoalbuminemia leads to decreased intravascular volume and increased blood viscosity.

### 3. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table
| Clinical Parameter | Prophylactic Anticoagulation Indicated (KDIGO 2021) | Prophylactic Anticoagulation Withheld |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Serum Albumin Level** | Serum Albumin < 2.0 - 2.5 g/dL | Serum Albumin > 3.0 g/dL |
| **Bleeding Risk Score** | Low Bleeding Risk (NO history of GI bleeding or severe thrombocytopenia) | High Bleeding Risk (Active ulcer, severe hypertension) |
| **First-Line Anticoagulant** | Low-Molecular-Weight Heparin (LMWH) or Warfarin / DOACs | N/A |

### 4. Pathophysiological Decision Tree
```
[Membranous Nephropathy with Serum Albumin < 2.5 g/dL]
       │
       ▼
[Assess Bleeding Risk vs Thrombotic Risk (KDIGO Section 3.3)]
       │
       ├─► High Bleeding Risk ──► Frequent Monitoring, Avoid Anticoagulation
       └─► Low Bleeding Risk ──► Initiate Prophylactic Anticoagulation (Warfarin / LMWH / DOAC)
                                       │
                                       ▼
                       [Continue until Serum Albumin > 3.0 g/dL]
```

### 5. Conceptual Trap Analysis
1. **Albumin Threshold Trap**: Prophylactic Anticoagulation 的建議切點為 Serum Albumin < 2.0-2.5 g/dL，而非僅看蛋白尿總量。(依據 KDIGO 2021 Practice Point 3.3.1)
2. **Renal Vein Thrombosis Presentation**: 若 MN Flank Pain 或急劇腎功能惡化，第一時間必須排除 Renal Vein Thrombosis (RVT)。

sections.title: Section 4: KDIGO 2021 Risk Stratification & Evidence-Based Therapeutics
sections.content:
### 1. KDIGO 2021 風險分層與循證治療指引 (KDIGO 2021 Guidelines & Therapeutics)

依據 *KDIGO 2021 Clinical Practice Guideline for Glomerular Diseases* Chapter 3 "Membranous Nephropathy" (Practice Points 3.2.1–3.2.4 & Figure 30) 與 *Brenner & Rector's The Kidney (11th ed.)* Chapter 33 "Treatment of Glomerulonephritis"：

Primary MN 之免疫抑制治療必須嚴格建立於 **KDIGO 2021 Risk Stratification Matrix**。非所有 MN 患者一診斷即需免疫抑制劑，Conservative Management。

#### Risk Categories & Therapeutic Strategies:
* **Low Risk**: eGFR 正常且 UPCR < 3.5 g/d (且 Anti-PLA2R < 20 RU/mL)。處置：保守治療（使用最高耐受劑量 ACEi/ARB 控制血壓與蛋白尿）觀察 6 個月。
* **Moderate Risk**: eGFR 正常且 UPCR 3.5–8.0 g/d (或 Anti-PLA2R 20–50 RU/mL) 持續 6 個月。處置：**Rituximab** (1000 mg IV Day 1 & 15) 或 **Calcineurin Inhibitor (CNI, Tacrolimus / Cyclosporine)**。
* **High Risk**: UPCR > 8.0 g/d 持續 >6 個月 OR Anti-PLA2R > 50 RU/mL OR eGFR 顯著下降。處置：**Rituximab** 或 **Cyclophosphamide + Steroids (Modified Ponticelli Regimen)**。
* **Very High Risk**: 威脅生命之腎病症候群或 eGFR 急劇惡化。處置：**Modified Ponticelli Regimen** (交替 6 個月口服/靜脈 Cyclophosphamide 與類固醇)。

### 2. Topology Mapping Matrix
* **KDIGO 2021 Risk Stratification for Primary MN**:
  - **Low Risk**: Normal eGFR AND UPCR < 3.5 g/d (or Anti-PLA2R < 20 RU/mL).
  - **Moderate Risk**: Normal eGFR AND UPCR 3.5 - 8.0 g/d (or Anti-PLA2R 20 - 50 RU/mL) stable over 6 months.
  - **High Risk**: UPCR > 8.0 g/d for > 6 months OR Anti-PLA2R > 50 RU/mL OR eGFR decline.
  - **Very High Risk**: Life-threatening Nephrotic Syndrome OR Rapidly Declining eGFR not attributable to complications.

### 3. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table
| Risk Category (KDIGO 2021) | Recommended Initial Immunosuppressive Therapy | Monitoring & Milestones |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Low Risk** | Conservative Management (Maximum tolerated RASi) for 6 months | Monitor UPCR, Serum Albumin, eGFR |
| **Moderate Risk** | Rituximab OR Calcineurin Inhibitor (Tacrolimus / Cyclosporine) | Check Anti-PLA2R titer at 3 & 6 months |
| **High Risk** | Rituximab OR Cyclophosphamide + Steroids (Modified Ponticelli Regimen) | Re-evaluate immunological response at 6 months |
| **Very High Risk** | Cyclophosphamide + Steroids (Modified Ponticelli Regimen) | Intensive eGFR and toxicities surveillance |

### 4. Pathophysiological Decision Tree
```
[Primary Membranous Nephropathy Diagnosis]
       │
       ├─► Low Risk ──► RASi Conservative Management for 6 months
       │
       ├─► Moderate Risk ──► Rituximab (1000 mg IV on Day 1 & 15) OR Tacrolimus
       │
       ├─► High Risk ──► Rituximab OR Modified Ponticelli Regimen
       │
       └─► Very High Risk ──► Alternating 6-month Cyclophosphamide + Corticosteroids
                                      │
                                      ▼
             [Monitor Serum Anti-PLA2R: Immunological Remission Precedes Clinical Remission]
```

### 5. Conceptual Trap Analysis
1. **Immunological vs Clinical Remission Trap**: Anti-PLA2R Immunological Remission 通常比 Proteinuria Clinical Remission **早出 3–6 個月**。不應因蛋白尿未立即消除而過早判定治療失敗或過度追加免疫抑制劑。(KDIGO 2021 Practice Point 3.2.3)
2. **CNI Relapse Rate Trap**: Calcineurin Inhibitors (Tacrolimus/Cyclosporine) 停藥後 Relapse Rate 很高（高達 40-50%），因此常需長期維持或與 Rituximab 併用。
